newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria OeBB awards train order to Siemens Austria.
newsitem.headline: Austria OeBB awards train order to Siemens Austria.

text.p: Austrian state railway OeBB said on Tuesday it had awarded an order worth around 2.8 billion schillings for 75 locomotives to Siemens AG Oesterreich, a unit of Germany's Siemens.
OeBB chief executive Helmut Draxler told Reuters the OeBB had an option to order a further 325 locomotives, worth an additional 13-14 billion schillings.
The initial batch of 75 high performance locomotives will be delivered between January, 2000 and the end of 2002, OeBB said in a statement.
"With this sizeable investment we are preparing ourselves for European competition. The locomotives can be used for goods and passenger traffic," the OeBB said.
It added that the locomotives were compatible with rail systems in Germany, Switzerland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, France and Belgium.

"With the award of this order, the OeBB is adding value in Austria. Siemens will buy some components from Austrian works and the final assembly of the locomotives will take place at the OeBB's Linz plant," it concluded.
